spec.definitions:
/-- TOY RIG 2: extraction from the GUARDED nest, the cheap-to-decide shape.  Same order 7,
    same purpose: validate the script before aiming it at order 41. -/
def T : List Nat := [1,6]
def e7 (i j : Nat) : Bool := ((i % 7 + 7 - j % 7) % 7) ∈ T

/-- guards HOISTED: adjacency tested outside the quantifier it guards -/
def gnest7 (e : Nat → Nat → Bool) : Bool :=
  (List.range 7).all fun a => (List.range 7).all fun b => (! (a < b)) || (! e a b) ||
    ((List.range 7).all fun c => (! (b < c)) || (! e a c) || (! e b c))

theorem gnest7_holds : gnest7 e7 = true := by decide

theorem gextract7 (e : Nat → Nat → Bool) (h : gnest7 e = true)
    (a b c : Nat) (ha : a < 7) (hb : b < 7) (hc : c < 7)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
    ¬ (e a b = true ∧ e a c = true ∧ e b c = true) := by
  rintro ⟨p1, p2, p3⟩
  have h1 := List.all_eq_true.mp h a (List.mem_range.mpr ha)
  have h2 := List.all_eq_true.mp h1 b (List.mem_range.mpr hb)
  simp only [hab, decide_true, Bool.not_true, p1, Bool.false_or] at h2
  have h3 := List.all_eq_true.mp h2 c (List.mem_range.mpr hc)
  simp only [hbc, decide_true, Bool.not_true, p2, p3, Bool.false_or] at h3

theorem gtoy_applied : ¬ (e7 0 1 = true ∧ e7 0 2 = true ∧ e7 1 2 = true) :=
  gextract7 e7 gnest7_holds 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
